plugin.name: Harry's Auto Filer
plugin.description: Automatically extracts content from Daily Notes based on hashtags and files them into designated folders
plugin.author: Harry Guinness

plugin.commands.name: init
plugin.commands.description: Initialize the plugin and create log entries

plugin.commands.name: Test Plugin
plugin.commands.description: Test if Harry's Auto Filer plugin is working correctly

plugin.commands.name: onEditorWillSave
plugin.commands.description: Processes content when a Daily Note with configured hashtags is saved

plugin.commands.name: Extract Content
plugin.commands.description: Manually extract content from the current note based on configured hashtags

plugin.settings.title: Hashtag-Folder Pairs
plugin.settings.description:
Enter hashtag and folder pairs (one per line). Format: #hashtag -> folder/path
Example:
#bookreview -> 30 - Resources/Books Read
#movie -> 30 - Resources/Movies

plugin.settings.title: Heading Name
plugin.settings.description: The H2 heading name to look for (without ##). Leave empty to use the hashtag as the heading.
